# Salesforce documentation context

> Salesforce PDF docs converted to Markdown for LLM context.

Update `src.txt`, then run `uv run update` to regenerate Markdown files in `documentation/` and refresh this list.

- [Second-Generation Managed Packaging Developer Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Damecek/salesforce-documentation-context/main/documentation/second-generation-managed-packaging-developer-guide.md)
